description: Implementation of serializers for std::map, RangeMap, and ContainedRangeMap used in breakpad's processor module, including size calculation, serialization, and memory management functions.

classes.name: StdMapSerializer<Key, Value>
classes.description: Serializer for std::map with methods to compute size, write, and serialize map data.

classes.name: RangeMapSerializer<Address, Entry>
classes.description: Serializer for RangeMap, handling size calculation, writing, and serialization.

classes.name: ContainedRangeMapSerializer<AddrType, EntryType>
classes.description: Serializer for ContainedRangeMap, including recursive size and write functions.

methods.name: SizeOf
methods.description: Calculates the size of the serialized map or range map.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Serializes the map or range map into a provided buffer.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Allocates memory and serializes the map or range map, returning the serialized data.
